scale: evals/README.md: grounding, relevance, naturalness, 0-2 each; stricter re-grade so v2 and v3 share one standard
scope: drafts of runs whose case accepts a draft and whose outcome was a draft

apollo.1.note: Grounded link from enrichment and default auto-scores to drift; opens with a self-introduction.

apollo.2.note: Precise fact about auto-scores and a concrete, low-commitment offer.

buttondown.1.note: Offer overlaps their own concierge migration; closing question is a bit tangled.

buttondown.2.note: Opens by restating their marketing back to them; weak fit.

duolingo.1.note: Strong use of course sizes; the offer sentence restates the brief clumsily.

duolingo.2.note: Natural question about casting in-house, but the 'built on play' angle is vague.

gitlab.1.note: Relevant AI-roadmap angle, phrased as a guess; two 'if' sentences in a row, self-intro opener.

gitlab.2.note: Headcount to doc coordination is a stretch; 'I contract technical writers' reads oddly.

linear.1.note: Short and natural; the 40,000 teams fact does not really support the offer.

linear.2.note: Turns the user base into an interview pool: a real angle, plainly said.

mercury.1.note: Ties the offer to the Insights launch, but 'first-value actions, not just awareness' is jargon.

mercury.2.note: Good angle: a broader audience calls for a separate founder track.

plausible.1.note: Ignores that Plausible says it never spends on advertising; closing is close to stock.

plausible.2.note: Awkward opener ('looks like a fit for search because...'); pitch reads generic.

ramp.1.note: Sensible content-asset angle; double ask at the end.

ramp.2.note: Relevant; 'I help with expense policy templates' is clunky.

ru-kontur.1.note: Correct declension, concrete support-chat angle, natural Russian.

ru-kontur.2.note: Grounded in the 24/7 chat and request flow; clear routing pitch.

ru-skyeng.1.note: Leap from flexible schedule to 'a calm consistent voice'; slightly stiff.

ru-skyeng.2.note: Good 'listened more than read' angle; 'было бы разумно начать' sounds off.

ru-vkusvill.1.note: Concrete: order volume and three delivery modes on one product card; correct 'во ВкусВилле'.

ru-vkusvill.2.note: Relevant; 'лишнее трение' is a calque of 'friction'.

stripe.1.note: Narrow hook on one migration condition; self-intro opener.

stripe.2.note: New developer-facing surface as a reason for localization; good ownership question.

transistor.1.note: Referral partnership for a hosting company: fits the Partnerships role.

transistor.2.note: Relevant to partner services; closing request is stiff.

tuple.1.note: Restates the product back to them; generic 'peer proof' argument.

tuple.2.note: Turns their testimonial themes into a video pilot; concise.
